name: heat-strip
title: Heat Strip
description: A year of weekly activity as one strip of thin bars — numbers row above (total / peak / current week), per-week hover tooltip, intensity doubled by opacity.

meta.question: Is this thing alive — how did its activity move over the last year?
meta.whenToUse: Liveness at a glance over a long window of weekly counts (repo activity, releases, posts) where the shape and recency matter more than exact values.
meta.antiUse: Not for exact value reading or short ranges (<12 weeks) — use a column chart instead.
